correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction: the actual equivariant surface-incidence gluing gives F_V=(p^3-1)/2 fixed signed nonzero vectors, F_P=(p^2-1)/2 decorated isotropic planes, F_E=F_P^2 fixed incidences. For any nontrivial power of an odd-order symplectic transvection, fixed planes contain its direction and are pointwise fixed. The connected graph chain complex contributes 1-F_V-F_P+F_E in H^1, and fixed genus-h surfaces contribute 2h F_P in H^1 and F_P in H^2. Weight-zero comparison and the rational C_p representations Q and Q(zeta_p) then yield t2, t3, a_i, b_i exactly for every odd prime; no claim of an equivariant wedge decomposition. Independently evaluated these integer expressions and graph polynomial for p=3,5,7,11,13, including the displayed p=3,5,7 dimension/trace/multiplicity tuples; that bounded computation is not the all-p proof. The equivariance of the canonical boundary-comparison map and the actual simplicial gluing, rather than a nonequivariant homotopy equivalence, are essential premises.
